title: Apply for a motor vehicle recycler licence
summary: This page explains how to apply for a motor vehicle recycler licence, which is required if your business includes recycling motor vehicles.
intro:
You need a motor vehicle recycler licence if your business includes:

You can apply for a 1-year, 3-year or 5-year licence, online.
who_can_apply: Be considered fit and proper for the purposes of the licence (NSW Fair Trading checks and considers police records).
Have sufficient financial resources to carry on your business in accordance with the requirements of Fair Trading.
Have approval from the relevant local council.
what_you_need: Personal details (name, address, and date of birth) of the individual or business partners.
Business details, including the registered name, address, and incorporation date.
Australian Company Number (ACN) or Australian Business Number (ABN).
If employing a business manager, a completed Manager's Consent Form.

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create an account.
Follow the prompts to apply for a licence.
Download and complete the relevant PDF form:
Submit your application with payment at a Service NSW Centre.

more_info.text: A corporation must nominate an individual to be manager of the day-to-day business of the licensee. An individual may manage the business themselves or nominate another individual to manage the business.

faqs.q: How long is the licence valid for?
faqs.a: You can apply for a licence that is valid for 1, 3, or 5 years.

faqs.q: Where can I pay the licence fees?
faqs.a: You can visit the NSW Fair Trading website for licensing fees, or check payment options at a service centre, noting that some centres may not accept cash.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You need proof of identity, personal and business details, ACN or ABN, and potentially a Manager's Consent Form if you employ a business manager.
